title: 4 GTA 6 systems explained before launch
yt_title: GTA 6 rates what kind of criminal you are 😳
description: Four GTA 6 systems explained before launch: the Criminal Profile (from Professional to Irredeemable), switching between Jason and Lucia, the RydeMe rideshare app used as fast travel, and a map Rockstar's developers call roughly twice the size of GTA 5's. Out November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
tiktok_caption: GTA 6 rates what kind of criminal you are 😳 Which system are you trying first? 👇

lines.text: GTA 6 rates what kind of criminal you are. From Professional, all the way to Irredeemable.
lines.headline: WHAT KIND OF CRIMINAL ARE YOU?

lines.text: That's one of four GTA 6 systems to understand before Thursday.
lines.headline: 4 SYSTEMS TO KNOW

lines.text: Number two: you play as Jason and Lucia, and you can switch between them almost anytime.
lines.headline: 2/4 · SWITCH ANYTIME

lines.text: And your relationship choices affect the story.
lines.headline: YOUR CHOICES MATTER

lines.text: Number three: RydeMe, a rideshare app that doubles as fast travel.
lines.headline: 3/4 · FAST TRAVEL

lines.text: Number four: the map. Rockstar's developers say it's roughly twice the size of GTA 5's.
lines.headline: 4/4 · THE MAP

lines.text: All in the state of Leonida: Vice City, the Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga.
lines.headline: WELCOME TO LEONIDA

lines.text: It launches Thursday, November 19th, on PS5 and Xbox Series.
lines.headline: LAUNCH DAY

lines.text: Which system are you trying first? Tell me below, and follow for confirmed GTA 6 news.
lines.headline: YOUR PICK?
